en: Black‑and‑white image showing two facing ranks of uniformed soldiers with rifles, being drilled by an officer in the middle. They wear pickelhaube spiked helmets and tunics typical of the Imperial German Army. The scene takes place on a street or courtyard bordered by brick buildings. In the background, a building bears a sign with German text that includes the words "Restaurant und Cafe".
